post.title: Does asking for a higher credit limit hurt your score?
post.ig:
Asking for a higher credit limit can cost points. Or add them.
Soft inquiries don't affect scores; hard inquiries can, and issuers differ. Capital One says it uses a soft inquiry for limit increases.
With a hard inquiry, myFICO says most people lose fewer than 5 points, counted for 12 months.
Hypothetical example: a $1,500 balance on a $5,000 limit is 30% utilization; on a $7,500 limit it's 20%.
Sources: CFPB, Experian, myFICO, VantageScore, Capital One, New York Fed (Q2 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
